scope: Admin Settings audit-key card through AdvancedAgentCapabilities
current_truth: Initial source repair passed guarded tests; independent review found a late storage-write gap. Expanded primitive repair passed guarded focused tests 10/10 and guarded TypeScript compilation. Independent re-review and native behavior remain open. Defect remains in-fix.

diagnosis.boundary: AuditKeyCard asynchronous operation handlers and first-load effect
diagnosis.root_cause: The first-load promise was not caught; export caught to console only; rotation joined the successful mutation and later refresh in one uncaught chain, so a failed refresh obscured a completed key change.
siblings: Initial and retried audit detail reads
diagnosis.repair: Each operation reports a visible result. Details retry performs reads only. Rotation success is recorded immediately after mutation, before refresh. Failed reads clear stale key details. Structured debug logging records only exception type, never error text or key contents. The device-key primitive imports before persistence, prepares public history before writing an active key, reads back a rejected active write, and reports an unknown outcome when readback also fails. Prepared public entries remain hidden until active; this does not claim atomic storage writes.

verification.green: Guarded run audit-key-green-20261003: 3/3 connected-component cases passed without unhandled rejection.
